quietplease.name: Quiet Please
quietplease.options.button.tooltip: Adjust each music track: volume, on/off, preview
quietplease.screen.mod.tooltip: Left click: next mod · Right click: previous mod
quietplease.screen.ambient.tooltip: Long sounds that are not music (for example Nether ambience)
quietplease.screen.reset_all.tooltip: Sets every track back to 100%% and on
quietplease.screen.now_playing.none: No music is playing right now
quietplease.screen.now_playing.tooltip: Click to find it in the list
quietplease.cmd.open_panel.tooltip: Open the sound panel (also available from Options → ♪ Quiet Please)
quietplease.cmd.dump.tooltip: Write the list to a file
quietplease.cmd.disable_all.tooltip: Turn off every track of this mod
quietplease.cmd.enable_all.tooltip: Turn on every track of this mod
quietplease.cmd.reset_all: All Quiet Please settings were reset.
quietplease.cmd.not_loaded: Saved, but no track with this name is loaded right now: %s
quietplease.settings.button.tooltip: Quiet Please settings: menu buttons, music gap, playlist mode
quietplease.settings.title: Quiet Please – Settings
quietplease.settings.now_playing_text.to: Show the name of the current song next to the ♪ Quiet Please button in the ESC and Options menus
quietplease.settings.show_ambient.toolti: Show long ambient loops in the panel's list by default
quietplease.settings.pause_button.toolti: Show the ♪ Quiet Please button in the ESC (game) menu. The panel is also in Mods → Config and /quietplease gui
quietplease.settings.options_button.tool: Show the ♪ Quiet Please button in Options and Music & Sounds
quietplease.settings.gap.vanilla.tooltip: The game's own pause between background songs (5–20 minutes in game)
quietplease.settings.gap.short.tooltip: 30 to 60 seconds of silence between background songs
quietplease.settings.gap.none.tooltip: The next background song starts right away
quietplease.settings.gap.custom.tooltip: Choose the shortest and longest pause with the sliders
quietplease.settings.gap.hint: The gap only changes background music (menu, game, biomes, underwater, Nether, End). Dragon, credits and boss music are not affected.
